body.name: Binary-coherent tail-band escape perturbation
body.construction:
Fix a target arm \(a\in\mathcal A_{\mathrm H}\) and put \(\epsilon_{a,n}=M_n^{-(\gamma_a-1)}\).  On the fitted tail band \(\{x:\widehat\pi_{a,-k}(x)\le M_n/\widehat h_{a,n}\}\), set
\[
 \widehat\pi^{\mathrm{esc}}_{a,-k}(x)
 =\min\{1-e^{-J_n},(1+\epsilon_{a,n})\widehat\pi_{a,-k}(x)\},
 \qquad
 \widehat\pi^{\mathrm{esc}}_{1-a,-k}(x)=1-\widehat\pi^{\mathrm{esc}}_{a,-k}(x).
\]
Outside that band leave the fitted pair unchanged.  If the lower range constraint is reached after complementation, project the target probability onto \([e^{-J_n},1-e^{-J_n}]\) and again define the other probability as its complement.  Compute \(E^{\mathrm{esc}}_{a,n}\) and \(D^{\mathrm{esc}}_{a,n}\) from this target-arm perturbation.  The construction perturbs one tail probability while preserving \(\widehat\pi^{\mathrm{esc}}_{0,-k}+\widehat\pi^{\mathrm{esc}}_{1,-k}=1\) pointwise.
